def.short: a reason you give for something wrong you did or did not do
def.long: A reason you give, true or not, to explain why you did something wrong or did not do something. People often say 'That's just an excuse!' when they do not believe it.

examples.en: That's not a good excuse for being late.
examples.tr: Bu, geç kalmak için iyi bir bahane değil.

examples.en: He always has an excuse for not doing homework.
examples.tr: Ödev yapmamak için hep bir bahanesi var.

examples.en: I need an excuse to leave this boring party.
examples.tr: Bu sıkıcı partiden çıkmak için bir bahaneye ihtiyacım var.

tr.note: İsim 'excuse' /ɪkˈskjuːs/ = bahane, mazeret. Fiil 'excuse' /ɪkˈskjuːz/ = bağışlamak; 'Excuse me' = Affedersiniz / Pardon.

quiz.cloze: That is not a good ______ for being late.

def.short: say that someone or something did a bad thing or caused a problem
def.long: To say or think that a person or thing caused something bad. You blame someone FOR a problem, or you blame a problem ON someone.

grammar.pattern: blame sb for sth / blame sth on sb

examples.en: Don't blame me. I wasn't there.
He blamed the traffic for being late.
She blames herself for the accident.

tr.note: 'Blame sb FOR sth' = birini bir şey yüzünden suçlamak; 'blame sth ON sb' = suçu birine atmak. Türkçedeki '-den dolayı suçlamak' için 'for' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: She blamed me about the mistake.
mistakes.right: She blamed me for the mistake.
mistakes.why: 'Bir şey yüzünden suçlamak' için 'blame FOR'; 'about' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: Don't ______ me for the mistake. I didn't do it.

def.short: a planned time when two people meet because they like each other romantically
def.long: A planned time when two people meet and spend time together because they like each other in a romantic way, for example at a restaurant or the cinema.

examples.en: I have a date on Friday night.
They went on a date to the cinema.
How was your date with Elif?

tr.note: Türkçe 'randevu' hem doktor randevusu hem romantik buluşma demektir. İngilizcede doktor randevusu 'appointment', romantik buluşma 'date' olur.

mistakes.wrong: I have a date at the dentist.
mistakes.right: I have an appointment at the dentist.
mistakes.why: 'Date' romantik buluşmadır; doktor, diş hekimi gibi randevular için 'appointment' kullanılır.

tr.mnemonic: 'Date' tarih demek. Takvimde günü belirlenen romantik buluşmaya da zamanla 'date' denmeye başlandı.

quiz.cloze: Tomorrow night I'm going on a ______ with Elif. I really like her.

def.short: put your arms around someone to show love or friendship
def.long: To put your arms around someone and hold them close, to show love, friendship, or comfort. People often hug when they meet or say goodbye.

examples.en: She hugged her mother at the airport.
Can I hug you? I missed you so much.
examples.tr: Sana sarılabilir miyim? Seni çok özledim.

examples.en: The kids hugged their grandpa and said goodbye.

tr.note: 'Hug' = sarılmak. Öpmek için 'kiss' kullanılır. 'Hug' isim olarak da kullanılır: 'Give me a hug!' = Bana sarıl!

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'birine sarılmak' deriz ama 'hug' doğrudan nesne alır; 'to' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: When I came home, my daughter ran to me and ______ me.

def.short: two people who are married or in a romantic relationship
def.long: Two people who are married or who have a romantic relationship. A couple may live together, or they may not.

examples.en: They are a lovely young couple.
The couple next door has two cats.
examples.tr: Yan dairedeki çiftin iki kedisi var.

examples.en: Ali and Elif have been a couple for three years.
examples.tr: Ali ile Elif üç yıldır birlikteler.

tr.note: 'A couple of' = birkaç / iki (a couple of days = birkaç gün); bu kartta 'couple' evli ya da sevgili olan iki kişidir.

quiz.cloze: That ______ has been married for fifty years.

def.short: a strong feeling of love for someone, often secret and not for long
def.long: A strong feeling of love for someone, usually not for long, often when you are young. You usually do not tell the person about it.

examples.en: I have a crush on my classmate.
Everyone knows he has a crush on Elif.
Sam was my first crush in high school.

tr.note: 'Have a crush on sb' = birinden hoşlanmak, ona platonik âşık olmak. 'My crush' = hoşlandığım kişi. Sevgili (boyfriend / girlfriend) değildir.

mistakes.wrong: I have a crush for him.
mistakes.right: I have a crush on him.

quiz.cloze: I've had a ______ on my coworker for months.

def.short: believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you or let you down
def.long: To believe that someone is honest and good, and that they will not hurt you or let you down. You can trust a person, or trust what they say.

grammar.pattern: trust sb / trust sb to do sth

examples.en: I trust my best friend completely.
You can trust me. I won't tell anyone.
Don't trust everything you read online.

tr.note: 'Trust' isim olarak da 'güven' demektir: 'I have trust in you'. 'Güvenilir' = 'reliable' ya da 'trustworthy'.

mistakes.why: 'Ona güveniyorum' derken 'trust' doğrudan nesne alır; 'to' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: I can't ______ him with my money. He lies all the time.

def.short: having agreed to marry someone, before the wedding
def.long: Having formally agreed to marry someone. An engaged couple often wears rings and starts to plan a wedding.

examples.en: My sister got engaged last month.
They are engaged and plan to marry next summer.
examples.tr: Nişanlılar ve önümüzdeki yaz evlenmeyi planlıyorlar.

examples.en: Are you engaged? That's a beautiful ring!
examples.tr: Nişanlı mısın? Çok güzel bir yüzük!

tr.note: 'Engaged' nişanlı, 'married' evli demektir. 'The line is engaged' gibi bir kullanımda 'meşgul' anlamına da gelir (İngiliz İngilizcesi), ama bu başka bir anlamdır.

mistakes.why: 'Biriyle nişanlı olmak' için 'engaged TO sb'; 'with' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: Ayşe and Kerem are ______ and will marry in June.

def.short: stop being angry with someone who did something wrong
def.long: To stop being angry with someone who did something wrong, and not want to punish them. People often say 'I forgive you' after someone says sorry.

examples.en: Please forgive me. I didn't mean it.
examples.tr: Lütfen beni affet. Kastım bu değildi.

examples.en: She forgave her brother for breaking her phone.
I can't forgive him for lying to me.
examples.tr: Bana yalan söylediği için onu affedemem.

tr.note: Düzensiz fiil: forgive - forgave - forgiven. 'Excuse me' = Affedersiniz (nezaket); 'forgive' ise gerçek bir hatayı affetmektir.

mistakes.wrong: I forgave him about the lie.
mistakes.right: I forgave him for the lie.
mistakes.why: 'Bir şey için affetmek' → 'forgive sb FOR sth'; 'about' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday. Please ______ me.

def.short: always supporting your friends, family, or team, even when it is difficult
def.long: Always supporting your friends, family, country, or team, even when times are hard. A loyal friend stays with you, and a loyal customer keeps coming back.

examples.en: Dogs are loyal to their owners.
Ali has been a loyal friend for many years.
She is loyal to her company, so she never left.
examples.tr: Şirketine sadık, bu yüzden hiç ayrılmadı.

tr.note: 'Loyal' yanında durmak ve bağlı kalmaktır. Türkçede 'vefalı' (iyiliği unutmayan) ve 'sadık' (bağlı) ikisini de karşılar.

mistakes.wrong: He is loyal with his friends.
mistakes.right: He is loyal to his friends.

quiz.cloze: A ______ friend always stays with you in bad times.
